description: This file defines the interface NoteClickListener with methods for handling click events on notes, specifically for note selection and favoriting actions within an Android application.

classes.name: NoteClickListener
classes.description: An interface that declares callback methods for note click events, including standard note selection and favorite toggling.

methods.name: onNoteClick
methods.description: Callback invoked when a note is clicked, with the note's position and the View that was clicked.

methods.name: onNoteFavoriteClick
methods.description: Callback invoked when the favorite icon or button on a note is clicked, with the note's position and the View that was clicked.
